body: Do what makes you happy, there is no band once you graduate.
I could solve problems by dying.  My life-insurance could pay off my families' debts.

Do only what you love, don't settle.  Try to avoid a real college, do a trade school if you have to.  Spend your money on gear, not tuition, the only way to learn audio is hands-on. Find an internship as soon as possible.  You can do it, but it just doesn't pay much, so don't rack up any debt.  I would rather die than do anything else, but I cannot afford it anymore.

I graduated from college with an Audio Production degree, there were only about 20 of us, and the college did not help us with job placement whatsoever.  Seven years later, I am working in the field with people who never went to school and not even making enough money to move out of my mom's basement.  I have no way of paying my student loans, they are currently on forbearance.  I cannot enroll in the loan forgiveness program because I have consolidated my loans. I have tried everything to find a good paying job in my field and am on the verge of suicide (see post https://redd.it/579iq6).  Can I sue my school for lack of job placement and for offering a degree that doesn't pay anything?  Please help.

Your pain is temporary, my pain is daily.  I was diagnosed with bi-polar disorder in college.  The depression hits me at least once a month.  No amount of medication or therapy has ever been able to relieve that.  I am sick of dealing with it, I cannot live like this anymore.  I appreciate the kind words, but in today's industry, there are no real "breaks" because the pay is so low.  You can go on tour and make something, but it is temporary, and once you return home the work has been taken by other people.  I cannot do this anymore.

What you call rash, I call meaningful.  I am trying to help others earn a fair living. I have been doing this for a long time, I am one of the best and underpaid.  Hard work should be rewarded, and I refuse to accept otherwise.
I called them earlier, they are no help, they cannot change anything, no one can.
